title: Sheinbaum Praised in China for Flying Economy and Welcomed with “Cielito Lindo”
author: Armando Montes
content:
_This article by[Armando
Montes](https://www.sinembargo.mx/author/amontesramz/) originally appeared in
the [November 18, 2026 edition of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4905834/elogian-a-sheinbaum-en-china-
por-volar-en-clase-economica-y-le-cantan-cielito-lindo/), a Mexican digital
news outlet._

_Internet users in the Asian country highlighted the Mexican government’s
austerity policy in comparison with other leaders’ travel arrangements._

**Mexico City, November 18 (SinEmbargo).-** **President Claudia Sheinbaum
Pardo** went viral on the Chinese social network Weibo after users highlighted
[that she flew economy class](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4905694/loteria-
nacional-del-martes-17-de-noviembre-consulta-todos-los-numeros-ganadores/) on
a commercial flight to attend the summit of the **Asia-Pacific Economic
Cooperation** (APEC) **forum** , being held in Shenzhen, China.

The president’s decision drew positive comments from users of the Chinese
platform, who praised her austerity policy and [compared it with the official
travel](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4905561/nadia-beller-desde-mexico-cerimedo-
no-es-ni-la-cabeza-de-la-mafia-entrevista/) of other heads of state. The
**president’s** team confirmed to the news agency _AFP_ that she used economy
class on a China Southern Airlines flight to reach the event.

The discussion spread widely on the platform. This Wednesday, the hashtag
“Mexican president **Sheinbaum** arrives in **Shenzhen** ” had accumulated
[more than 10.2 million views](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4905756/indigenas-
aislados-salen-de-la-selva-a-pedir-comida-madereros-les-quitan-la-tierra/).
The president’s arrival also drew attention because of the welcome she
received at the airport, where she was taken by bus to the red carpet laid out
on the tarmac.

## Praise for Claudia Sheinbaum

![Claudia Sheinbaum stands with other APEC leaders for an official group
photograph.](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/11/sheinbaum-economy-class-china-inline-1.jpg)President
Claudia Sheinbaum participated in the APEC 2026 leaders’ family photograph.
Photo: Presidency.

According to the news agency, several users of the platform said they had
encountered **Claudia Sheinbaum** during the flight to China. One of them
posted photographs purportedly showing the president talking with passengers,
although the agency said it could not verify those images.

“The president of Mexico (64 years old and with a doctorate in energy
engineering) arrived on a China Southern Airlines flight in economy class,”
one user wrote.

The posts drew favorable comments about the president’s decision. Some
internet users highlighted that taking a commercial flight is a way to
safeguard public resources and avoid spending considered excessive on official
travel.

“It is praiseworthy to spend taxpayers’ money frugally and make sure it is
used where it is most needed, instead of wasting it on luxurious private
planes or official travel expenses,” another user commented.

Sheinbaum’s austerity policy has its roots in the government of **Andrés
Manuel López Obrador** , her predecessor and political ally. During his
administration, the then-president promoted measures to reduce government
spending and put Mexico’s presidential plane up for sale in 2023.

Sheinbaum also does not tend to travel internationally often, and when she
does, she uses commercial flights that fit her schedule. Before leaving for
China, the president had warned that the journey would take almost two days of
flying and that the time difference would pose a challenge.

## Sheinbaum’s Welcome in China

> [Post by @rosaicela_ on
> X](https://x.com/rosaicela_/status/2123121502878945614)

One of the moments that drew attention during the Mexican president’s arrival
was a performance of “Cielito Lindo” by a chamber orchestra providing music
for the reception at the **Shenzhen** International Exchange Center.

**Xi Jinping** welcomed Sheinbaum at the venue alongside his wife, **Peng
Liyuan** , before the regional summit’s welcome banquet. Images the president
herself shared on social media show the musicians behind her as the welcome
unfolded.

The performance drew comments on digital platforms, where some users described
the moment as though those attending had sung the Mexican song. However, the
material shared by Sheinbaum shows that it was an instrumental performance by
the orchestra.

The Mexican melody formed part of the welcome for the international
representatives who attended the dinner hosted by the Chinese president during
the 33rd **APEC** Economic Leaders’ Meeting.

The meeting is taking place on November 18 and 19 in **Shenzhen** , under
China’s chairmanship. It brings together the forum’s 21 member economies and
serves as a platform for addressing economic and trade cooperation in the
Asia-Pacific region.
